"""One Data-Free construction using full-prefix and local task responses."""
import copy
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

from _impl.io import digest
from _impl.metrics import logical_parameter_distance
from _impl.models import checked_models, initialize


def main():
    initialize()
    started = time.monotonic()
    protocol = Path("results/data_free_compensation/local_prefix_protocol.json")
    cfg = json.loads(protocol.read_text())
    assert digest(__file__) == cfg["source_sha256"]
    out = Path(cfg["output"])
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    (out / "protocol.json").write_text(protocol.read_text())
    (out / "construction.py").write_text(Path(__file__).read_text())
    _, expert, head, pins = checked_models("MNIST")
    expert, head = expert.cuda(), head.cuda()
    student = copy.deepcopy(expert)
    path = Path(cfg["basis"]["path"])
    assert digest(path) == cfg["basis"]["sha256"]
    entries = {v["source_key"]: v for v in torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False).values()}
    images = []
    for ref in cfg["inputs"]:
        assert digest(ref["path"]) == ref["sha256"]
        images.append(torch.load(ref["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)["normalized_images"])
    images = torch.cat(images).cuda()
    teacher_prefixes, teacher_outputs = {}, {}
    hooks = []
    for i, block in enumerate(expert.model.visual.transformer.resblocks):
        hooks.append(block.ln_2.register_forward_pre_hook(
            lambda module, args, layer=i: teacher_prefixes.__setitem__(layer, args[0].clone())))
        hooks.append(block.mlp.register_forward_hook(
            lambda module, args, output, layer=i: teacher_outputs.__setitem__(layer, output.clone())))
    with torch.no_grad():
        teacher_scores = head(expert(images))
    for hook in hooks:
        hook.remove()
    counters = dict(synthetic_model_forwards=64, local_feature_vector_forwards=0,
                    A_inner_iterations=0, A_objective_evaluations=0,
                    real_images=0, original_expert_updates=0, input_pixel_updates=0, AGA_calls=0)
    rows = []
    for i, (block, changed) in enumerate(zip(expert.model.visual.transformer.resblocks,
                                            student.model.visual.transformer.resblocks)):
        prefix = {}
        hook = changed.ln_2.register_forward_pre_hook(lambda module, args: prefix.update(r=args[0].clone()))
        with torch.no_grad():
            student(images)
        hook.remove()
        counters["synthetic_model_forwards"] += len(images)
        rs, rt = prefix["r"], teacher_prefixes[i]
        A, a, B = block.mlp.c_fc.weight, block.mlp.c_fc.bias, block.mlp.c_proj.weight.double()
        key = f"model.visual.transformer.resblocks.{i}.mlp.c_fc.weight"
        V = entries[key]["v"].cuda()
        N = torch.linalg.qr(V, mode="complete").Q[:, V.shape[1]:]
        AN = A.double() @ N
        eye = torch.eye(N.shape[1], dtype=torch.float64, device="cuda")
        G = V / block.ln_2.weight.double()[:, None]
        _, _, vh = torch.linalg.svd(G.sum(0, keepdim=True), full_matrices=True)
        Q = torch.linalg.qr(G @ vh[1:].T, mode="reduced").Q
        with torch.no_grad():
            x = changed.ln_2(rs).reshape(-1, 768)
            yc = (rt + teacher_outputs[i] - rs - block.mlp.c_proj.bias).reshape(-1, 768).double().T
            epsilon = .01 * (rt[0].double().var(-1, unbiased=False) + block.ln_2.eps).sqrt()
            delta = (epsilon[:, None, None] * (768 ** .5) * Q.T[None]).float()
            xp = changed.ln_2((rs[0, :, None] + delta).reshape(-1, 768))
            xm = changed.ln_2((rs[0, :, None] - delta).reshape(-1, 768))
            yp = block.mlp(block.ln_2((rt[0, :, None] + delta).reshape(-1, 768))).double()
            ym = block.mlp(block.ln_2((rt[0, :, None] - delta).reshape(-1, 768))).double()
            yd = ((yp - ym).reshape(64, 31, 768) / (2 * epsilon[:, None, None])).reshape(-1, 768).T
            nc, nd = yc.norm(), yd.norm()
            Y = torch.cat([yc / nc, yd / nd], dim=1)
        counters["local_feature_vector_forwards"] += 2 * len(xp)
        raw = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros_like(eye))
        ridge = .01 / B.square().sum()
        identity_hidden = torch.eye(3072, dtype=torch.float64, device="cuda")
        evaluations = 0

        def fit():
            T = raw - raw.T
            C = torch.linalg.solve(eye - T, eye + T)
            K = (C - C.T) / 2
            S = -torch.linalg.solve(eye - K, eye + K)
            Ap = (A.double() + AN @ (S - eye) @ N.T).float()
            hc = block.mlp.gelu(F.linear(x, Ap, a)).double().T
            hp = block.mlp.gelu(F.linear(xp, Ap, a)).double()
            hm = block.mlp.gelu(F.linear(xm, Ap, a)).double()
            hd = ((hp - hm).reshape(64, 31, 3072) / (2 * epsilon[:, None, None])).reshape(-1, 3072).T
            H = torch.cat([hc / nc, hd / nd], dim=1)
            with torch.no_grad():
                features = H.detach()
                rhs = (Y - B @ features) @ features.T
                gram = features @ features.T + ridge * identity_hidden
                change = torch.cholesky_solve(rhs.T, torch.linalg.cholesky(gram)).T
                Bp = B + change
            error = Y - Bp @ H
            loss = error.square().sum() + ridge * change.square().sum()
            counters["local_feature_vector_forwards"] += len(x) + 2 * len(xp)
            return loss, Ap, Bp, hc, hd

        optimizer = torch.optim.LBFGS([raw], lr=1., max_iter=40, max_eval=60,
                                     history_size=5, line_search_fn="strong_wolfe")

        def closure():
            nonlocal evaluations
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            loss = fit()[0]
            assert torch.isfinite(loss)
            loss.backward()
            evaluations += 1
            return loss

        initial_loss = float(closure().detach())
        initial_gradient = float(raw.grad.norm())
        optimizer.step(closure)
        with torch.no_grad():
            loss, Ap, Bp, hc, hd = fit()
            changed.mlp.c_fc.weight.copy_(Ap)
            changed.mlp.c_proj.weight.copy_(Bp.float())
            row = dict(layer=i, objective_before=initial_loss, objective_after=float(loss),
                       initial_gradient_norm=initial_gradient,
                       A_relative_change=float((Ap.double() - A).norm() / A.norm()),
                       B_relative_change=float((Bp - B).norm() / B.norm()),
                       A_task_change=float(((Ap.double() - A) @ V).norm() / A.norm()),
                       center_relative_error=float((Bp @ hc - yc).norm() / nc),
                       direction_relative_error=float((Bp @ hd - yd).norm() / nd),
                       iterations=int(optimizer.state[raw]["n_iter"]), objective_evaluations=evaluations)
        counters["A_inner_iterations"] += row["iterations"]
        counters["A_objective_evaluations"] += evaluations
        rows.append(row)
        print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
        del optimizer, raw, hc, hd, Bp, Ap
    with torch.no_grad():
        student_scores = head(student(images))
    counters["synthetic_model_forwards"] += len(images)
    assert all(p.grad is None for model in [expert, head] for p in model.parameters())
    original_state = {k: v.cpu() for k, v in expert.state_dict().items()}
    edits = {k: v.cpu() for k, v in student.state_dict().items() if not torch.equal(v.cpu(), original_state[k])}
    assert len(edits) == 24 and all(k.endswith(("mlp.c_fc.weight", "mlp.c_proj.weight")) for k in edits)
    torch.save(edits, out / "publication.pt")
    torch.save(dict(teacher=teacher_scores.cpu(), student=student_scores.cpu()), out / "source_scores.pt")
    agreement = int((teacher_scores.argmax(1) == student_scores.argmax(1)).sum())
    result = dict(rows=rows, counters=counters, seconds=time.monotonic() - started,
                  publication=dict(path=str(out / "publication.pt"), sha256=digest(out / "publication.pt")),
                  source_scores_sha256=digest(out / "source_scores.pt"), source_agreement=[agreement, 64],
                  source_passed=agreement == 64 and all(r["A_relative_change"] <= 2.00001 and r["B_relative_change"] <= 4 for r in rows),
                  checkpoint_sha256=pins, parameter_distance=logical_parameter_distance(edits, original_state),
                  source_sha256=digest(__file__), source=Path(__file__).read_text())
    (out / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    print("CONSTRUCTION_DONE", json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k not in ["rows", "source"]}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
